scope: Settings uses Finder glass, sidebar rows and window borders, with new Top bar and Dock illustrations.

checks.command: Compared Finder and Settings in light and dark mode in isolated KDE neon Wayland guests with each edition’s defaults. Captured the approved replacement artwork in Golden Gate Settings.
Built the Acrylic Glass effect with KWin SDKs 6.6.5, 6.7.4 and 6.8.2. Loaded the candidate X11 module into a private KWin session and captured the Settings frame and its blur region.

approval: Maintainer approved the Settings candidate after the final artwork preview.
coverage_limits: Wayland comparison frames precede the artwork swap. The final artwork frame shows the dark Golden Gate Dock page. The isolated X11 capture covers Settings rendering. The integrated release preserves the separately shipped launcher shortcut editor.
